min.description: Minimum value setting. Note that this will not be the effective minimum if minExclusive is set.

max.description: Maximum value setting. Note that this will be the effective maximum only if maxInclusive is set.

minExclusive.description: If true, treat the min value as outside the valid range.

maxInclusive.description: If true, treat the max value as within the valid range.

title:
Declared range of comparable values, usually numeric primitives. The range may be declared with a minimum and/or
a maximum, either of which may be inclusive or exclusive. By default minimum is inclusive and maximum is exclusive.
This should only be used for types that have natural comparisons.
name: Range
